steps.code:
# Parse all habit notes to extract date and habit values
import re

habit_data = []
habit_order = None

for note in habit_notes:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            name, value = line.split(':', 1)
            name = name.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            if value not in ('yes', 'no'):
                print(f"Unexpected value in note {note['note_id']}: {name}: {value}")
            habits[name] = value
    
    if habit_order is None:
        # Capture order from first note
        habit_order = list(habits.keys())
    else:
        # Verify same order
        if list(habits.keys()) != habit_order:
            print(f"Order mismatch in note {note['note_id']}")
    
    habit_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

print(f"Parsed {len(habit_data)} notes")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First entry:", habit_data[0])

# Parse all habit notes to extract date and habit values
import re

habit_rows = []  # list of (date_str, dict_of_habits)
habit_order = None

for note in all_habit_notes:
    note_id = note['note_id']
    title = note['title']
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        print(f"Skipping note {note_id} - no date in title: {title}")
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id)
    content = detail['content']
    # Parse lines that look like "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            if len(parts) == 2:
                name = parts[0].strip()
                value = parts[1].strip().lower()
                if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                    habits[name] = value
    if not habits:
        print(f"Note {note_id} has no habit entries")
        continue
    if habit_order is None:
        habit_order = list(habits.keys())
    else:
        # Verify order matches
        if list(habits.keys()) != habit_order:
            print(f"Note {note_id} has different habit order: {list(habits.keys())}")
    habit_rows.append((date_str, habits))

print(f"Parsed {len(habit_rows)} notes")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First few rows:")
for d, h in habit_rows[:3]:
    print(d, h)
